$comment: Case D (docs/overrides-redesign.md spec item 2, Building blocks item 9): the places still allowed to name the raw feat stores. Every reader of the feats a build HOLDS asks src/rules/heldFeats.ts (heldFeatSlots / heldFeatIds / featIdAtSlot), so a feat given through Tweaks works like the same feat picked. Keys: <file>#<enclosing symbol chain>, count = reads there (scripts/lib/feat-readers.mjs). Checked by checkFeatReaders (src/rules/blocks/check.ts) in scripts/blocks-check.mjs: an unlisted key, a count above or below the listed one, an empty why or a stale entry fails. A new walker routes through heldFeats.ts; only slot geometry, slot UI, storage and D2 (a given feat's own question has no Builder control yet) belong here.

src/builder/Builder.tsx#Builder.why: Slot card UI: 'Move to slot' re-checks on the live build that the slot still holds the feat before swapping slot keys: a given feat holds no slot to move. (Plan B WP8 took the other read: featQuestions' 'choose a different spell each time' set now walks heldFeatSlots, a given taking included.)

src/builder/Builder.tsx#Builder>isCurren.why: The feat picker marks the feat sitting in THIS slot now: the slot's own pick.

src/builder/Builder.tsx#Builder>listAddi.why: useMemo dependency only: the memo body reads heldFeatIds(build), so it re-runs when a slot pick changes; build.overrides and build.options are listed beside it for the given feats.
useMemo dependency only (the second class's pool): the memo body reads heldFeatIds(build); build.overrides and build.options are listed beside it.

src/builder/Builder.tsx#Builder>noOpWhy.why: The picker never greys the feat already in THIS slot (featPrereqChar includes that take): the slot's own pick.

src/builder/Builder.tsx#Builder>noSlot.why: Slot geometry: picks at this level under a key no drawn slot produces (stranded by an old version or a slot change) are listed to move or remove. A given feat has no slot key to strand.

src/builder/Builder.tsx#Builder>slotPick.why: The slot card draws its own pick (featPicks of a drawn slot key): a book slot's, or an extra feat place's own slot card (Tweaks phase 2 WP7: slotPickLines serves both, so a place's pick gets the same notes and questions).

src/builder/Builder.tsx#hasChoicesAtLeve.why: Slot choices only: did the player pick a feat on this level's page (lowering the level past it asks first). A given feat is not a choice made on a level page.

src/builder/shared.tsx#OriginPickers>cla.why: The class-change confirm names what the change clears: changeClass empties the slot picks (featPicks: {}), never overrides.addedFeats.

src/builder/shared.tsx#OriginPickers>req.why: The ancestry-change confirm counts the ancestry SLOT picks that changeAncestry drops; given feats are not dropped.

src/builder/shared.tsx#subclassSwapDrops.why: Slot writer: Battle Creed puts Battle Harbinger Dedication in the level-2 class SLOT, and a later subclass change takes it out. It reads and rewrites that one slot.
Slot writer (the same Battle Creed slot): the map it starts from before rewriting the level-2 slot.

src/builder/shared.tsx#useBuilderActions.why: Slot writer: an ancestry change writes back the slot picks without the ancestry slots.
Slot writer: drops the ancestry slot picks from the stored map.

src/builder/shared.tsx#withSubclass.why: Slot writer: stores subclassSwapDrops' new featPicks map (the Battle Creed slot). The pure reducer changeSubclass and the subclass Take anyway share (WP4).

src/builder/shared.tsx#withoutPicks>gone.why: A confirm's yes clears the answers of the SLOT picks it named, only while each slot still holds the feat it named.

src/rules/build.ts#answersInOtherTakes.why: Compares a slot taking's answers with the feat's OTHER slot takings. A given feat is deduped against slot takes (one taking per feat), so it has no other take to look across.

src/rules/build.ts#buildCharacter.why: The slot push: slot takings enter character.feats first, in featPicks order (slot authority). The given feats are pushed after them from heldFeatSlots(build, level, { via: ['override'] }).

src/rules/build.ts#buildCharacter>grante.why: The order of the stored slot keys, to cap a pick-granted feat's takings in the pick walk's own order; an override: key sorts last, as heldFeatSlots lists given feats last.

src/rules/build.ts#collectChosenIds.why: Storage: lists every id the stored build names (the raw maps) for the content check. Not a held-feats question.

src/rules/build.ts#deriveBuildFromCharac.why: Storage: the reverse build WRITES featPicks from a built character — a row into the real slot it lands in, and (tweaks p2 WP7, C43) an extra feat place's row under its own exact key.

src/rules/build.ts#heldPickGranters.why: Slot authority of the pick-a-feat walk: an answer keyed by a slot reads that slot's feat, and a bare-id answer lists the slots that fall back to it. The given-feat side of the same walk reads heldFeatSlots (overrideHolds).

src/rules/build.ts#heldPickGranters>slot.why: Slot authority: which SLOT takings of a feat the pick walk keeps (featPicks order, maxTakes cap). A given feat is the override: branch.
Slot authority: the feat a slot key holds, for the slot branch of the pick walk.

src/rules/build.ts#levelChoices.why: Empty-slot count: a drawn slot with no pick owes a feat (slot geometry; a given feat fills no slot). (Plan B WP8: the follow-up questions loop and the owed-cantrip loop read heldFeatSlots now, a given feat's on page TWEAKS_PAGE.)

src/rules/build.ts#removeChosenIds>next.why: Storage: rewrites the stored featPicks map without the removed ids.

src/rules/slotKey.ts#SLOT_KEYED.why: The names of the stored maps keyed by slot, which a slot move rekeys (featSlots.ts re-exports it; a leaf so Character.tweakKept reads the same list, tweaks p2 C46). Reads no character.

src/rules/blocks/write.ts#heldUnderPlace.why: Storage (tweaks p2 WP7, C12): the write door's move lock asks what the build STORES under an extra feat place's key — any pick, live, paused or Tweaks off — so a filled place never moves and leaves its pick behind. Reads no held feat.

src/rules/tweakKept.ts#restoreKeptFeatPl.why: Storage writer (tweaks p2 WP7, C46): the reverse build puts a paused or Tweaks-off extra place's pick back under its own key, from Character.tweakKept, only where no pick is held (read through featIdAtSlot).

src/rules/tweakKept.ts#keptFeatCopies.why: Storage (tweaks p2 WP8, fixes round 1): what the build STORES in each book slot, so a copy the take cap dropped (no Character.feats row) while a moreTakes block for its feat is stored is kept in Character.tweakKept for a build-less reopen. It must see the dropped copy, which no held-feat reader lists.

src/rules/featSlots.ts#fitsSlot.why: Slot geometry: would the slot's picker take the feat moved from one slot to another. A given feat has no slot.

src/rules/featSlots.ts#fitsSlot>featPick.why: Slot geometry: the stored map with the feat moved to the target slot.

src/rules/featSlots.ts#fitsSlot>id.why: Slot geometry: the feat in the slot being moved.

src/rules/featSlots.ts#slotBookRefusals.why: Slot geometry (tweaks p2 WP5): the book's refusals of a slot's pick, read as fitsSlot reads it. A given feat has no slot.

src/rules/featSlots.ts#slotBookRefusals>.why: Slot geometry (tweaks p2 WP5): the stored map with the feat moved to the target slot, as fitsSlot builds it.
Slot geometry (tweaks p2 WP5): the feat in the slot whose refusals are read.

src/rules/featSlots.ts#moveTargetFor.why: Slot geometry: the first EMPTY slot of the kind that takes a stranded pick.

src/rules/featSlots.ts#picksLosingSlot>d.why: Slot geometry: which slot picks a drawn slot held before a rules change.

src/rules/featSlots.ts#picksLosingSlot>k.why: Slot geometry: the slot picks still kept after a rules change.

src/rules/featSlots.ts#rekeyFeatSlots.why: Slot geometry: a pick whose slot key no longer holds a feat is stale (slot rekey).

src/rules/featSlots.ts#rekeyFeatSlots>re.why: Slot geometry: a slot pick the target slot's own picker would refuse.

src/rules/featSlots.ts#withFeat.why: THE slot writer (tweaks p2 WP1, C44: moved out of the Builder's setFeat so a tweak's patch places a feat the same way): sets or clears one slot's pick.

src/rules/featSlots.ts#withFeat>featPick.why: THE slot writer (tweaks p2 WP1, C44): copies the stored map to change one slot.

src/rules/blocks/check.ts#LEGACY_KEYS.why: The names of today's 10 Overrides keys, checked against the registry's storage.key. Reads no character.

src/rules/blocks/registry.ts#BLOCK_KINDS.why: grant.feat's storage.key names the stored key it wraps; stored.ts is what reads it.

src/rules/blocks/stored.ts#activeGivenFe.why: THE stored reader of given feats: the active ones, cached per overrides object (re-read when addedFeats or meta changes).

src/rules/blocks/stored.ts#readGivenFeat.why: THE stored reader: feeds the stored list to readLegacyBlocks for activeGivenFeats.

src/rules/blocks/stored.ts#readLegacyBlo.why: THE stored reader: today's addedFeats entries read as grant.feat blocks; the same walk records where each one is stored (the 'addedFeats' list name of legacyEntries, plan B WP1), so writers never build a key by hand.

src/rules/blocks/write.ts#LEVELLED.why: Storage writer: the write door (plan B 5.1) names the list keys whose entries carry their own stored level (B10). Reads no character.

src/rules/blocks/write.ts#addLegacy.why: Storage writer: the write door (plan B 5.1) appends a given feat to the stored list (the 'Give a feat' add).

src/rules/blocks/write.ts#updateLegacy.why: Storage writer: the write door (plan B 5.1) rewrites one stored given-feat entry in place (its feat, stored level and category) and moves its meta with it.

src/rules/blocks/write.ts#updateLegacy>i.why: Storage writer: the write door (plan B 5.1) picks the id field of the stored entry it rewrites (featId for addedFeats, featureId for addedFeatures).

src/rules/build.ts#collectChosenIds.why: Storage: lists every id the stored build names, given feats included, for the content check.

src/rules/build.ts#deriveBuildFromCharac.why: Storage writer: the reverse build's overflow names the stored list ('addedFeats') to markImported (blocks/write.ts), which stamps only the entries it appended source 'import' (plan B WP2, spec 2). Reads no held feat.
Storage: the reverse build skips feats the character's stored overrides already give, so a given feat never fills a slot on reopen.
Storage: the reverse build's overflow WRITES feats with no slot into the stored list.

src/rules/build.ts#removeChosenIds.why: Storage: names the stored list ('addedFeats') to dropEntries (blocks/write.ts, plan B WP2), which rewrites it without the removed ids and drops their meta.
